hero.title: Zhipeng folk songs
hero.subtitle: Songs that grew out of work in the paper sheds

videoHint: Video playback may use significant data — Wi-Fi recommended
paras: Zhipeng folk songs are associated with the workshops that made Biaoxin paper, a traditional Wanzai bamboo paper. Local accounts trace the songs to the Ming dynasty.
The songs follow the work of cutting and soaking bamboo and drying paper. The lyrics also tell stories about courtship, farming and hopes for the harvest.
Jiangxi Province recognizes the songs as intangible cultural heritage. They preserve a record of the work and everyday lives of Wanzai’s papermakers.
